gameName: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth
firstPlayerRule: The Sauron player takes the first turn. Players then alternate turns.
clarifications: Choose or randomly determine who plays Sauron and who plays the Fellowship during setup.
Turn alternation continues across chapter boundaries; the player who ends one chapter does not automatically start the next.
